scope.summary: Wire the raster-domain StudioLayer.kind discriminants and their create/convert commands over the canonical 14.23 StudioLayer primitive: raster (pixel layer of StudioRasterTile), placed_asset, group (default Pass Through), adjustment, live_filter, fill, and mask. Each kind exposes a typed create command + a layers-panel creation control; payload contracts are canonical in 14.23 and MUST NOT be forked. Group default blend is Pass Through per STU-RAS-040.
acceptance_criteria: all 7 raster StudioLayer kinds creatable via typed command + GUI
payloads canonical to 14.23; group defaults Pass Through; events promotion-gated
expected_tests: live: create each of the 7 raster layer kinds via typed command; each appears in layers panel with correct kind discriminant
argus: layers-panel snapshot shows kind + stable author_ids
test: kinds resolve to canonical 14.23 StudioLayer payloads (no forked type)

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Layer kinds and creating layers

risk_if_missed: No raster layer taxonomy; downstream painting/adjustment/mask MTs have no target layer kinds.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
